title.en: Advanced diagnostic endoscopy for lesion characterisation

description.en: Systematic pre-ESD lesion assessment: Paris classification, IPCL/Sano/simplified NBI/vessel-plus-surface/depth-predicting scores, Kudo/NICE/JNET pit and vascular patterns. Prerequisite to any ESD.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for advanced diagnostic endoscopy for lesion characterisation but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs advanced diagnostic endoscopy for lesion characterisation independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches advanced diagnostic endoscopy for lesion characterisation to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
